snippet.title: Roadside Research | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Cybernetic Walrus and Oro Interactive are excited to announce Roadside Research, a 1 to 4 player co-op gas station simulator. Except you’re aliens. And undercover. Do very human things like restocking shelves while preparing for the invasion. Just don’t get caught.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3643170/Roadside_Research/
